In this paper, an efficient UWB channel modeling scheme is presented. First, the channel is simulated using single antenna on both sides of the system by taking into account both reflection and refraction of the transmitted ray. The dense multipath channel of UWB is then efficiently exploited by using different configuration of multiple antennas on both sides (transmit/receive sides). Simulation results show great improvement in channel impulse response (CIR) in case of multiple antennas. Moreover, this improvement in CIR is monotonically gradual in the sense that the CIR becomes denser upon increasing number of antennas on both sides of the system. The modelling scheme is based on ray tracing algorithm that has been developed using the art of computer game technology.

articleTitle: The circulate property of generator matrices of protograph LDPC codes
publicationTitle: IET 3rd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMNN 2010)
abstract: The LDPC application involves the problem: encoding complexity. Since the generator matrices are dense and with random positions of "1s", the encoder needs to store every "1" of the generator matrices by using huge chip area. To solve problem, we need to design the LDPC codes with block cyclic generator matrices. This paper reveals that the protograph LDPC codes can have lower encoding complexity under the condition of the proposed theorem that the parity check matrices of the LDPC codes are nonsingular and circulate. The circulate property of generator matrix of protograph LDPC codes can be obtained from the quasi-cyclic parity check matrix of protograph LDPC codes. Thus it can reduce the encoding complexity. We give an algorithm of protograph LDPC codes with fast encoding based on the theorem, and it verifies that protograph LDPC codes with circulate property of generator matrices can simplify encoder hardware implementation.

articleTitle: Scintillation of a tracked Gaussian beam for ground-to-satellite laser communication
publicationTitle: IET 3rd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMNN 2010)
abstract: Recent researches have revealed that, for a tracked uplink Gaussian beam, the scintillation index predicted by the weak fluctuation theory is significantly different from that of the numerical wave optics simulation method when the size of the transmitter aperture is large. In this paper, turbulence-induced scintillation index and the probability distribution of fluctuating irradiance for a tracked uplink Gaussian beam are studied using numerical wave optics simulation method. The simulated data show that in the discrepancy region between the weak fluctuation theory and the numerical simulation method, the simulated fluctuating irradiance is not governed by the generally accepted lognormal distribution even when the weak fluctuation condition is still satisfied.

articleTitle: Regularized direct Linear Graph Embedding
publicationTitle: IET 3rd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMNN 2010)
abstract: Linear Graph Embedding (LGE) is the linearization of graph embedding, which could explain many of the popular dimensionality reduction algorithms such as LDA, LLE and LPP. LGE algorithms have been applied in many domains successfully; however, those algorithms need a PCA transform in advance to avoid a possible singular problem. In this paper, a regularized direct linear graph embedding algorithm is proposed by imposing Tikhonov regularizer on the objective function of LGE. Further, we extract features from the original data set directly by solving common Eigen value problem of symmetric positive semi definite matrix. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Architecture of network robot control server software written in a Rule-based language
publicationTitle: IET 3rd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMNN 2010)
abstract: If robots of different models are to provide the same networked robot service, it is desirable that they are able to use the same service programs. In this paper, we propose the architecture of networked robot control server software that allows the same service programs to be used by different robot models. Specifically, we define robot-model-independent common signals, and propose a robot control algorithm that focuses on "has-a" relations in robot control functions. We have developed a networked robot control server that implements the proposed architecture and algorithm and uses STAR (SofΓware Architecture using Rule-based language). To evaluate the proposed algorithm, we have developed an experimental system that provides a "Garbage Collection Service," and uses two robot models: AIBO and AmigoBot.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of eXplicit Control Protocol (XCP)
publicationTitle: IET 3rd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMNN 2010)
abstract: Mathematical analysis of current congestion control algorithms reveals that, as the delay-bandwidth product (BDP) increases, TCP becomes more oscillatory and prone to instability, regardless of the queuing scheme. To address this problem, a novel approach to Internet congestion control is developed recently. This new explicit Control Protocol (XCP) delivers the highest possible application performance over a broad range of network infrastructure, including extremely high speed and very high delay links that are not well served by TCP. We analyze the performance of XCP and make comparation with TCP. Extensive simulations show that XCP achieves fair bandwidth allocation, high utilization, small standing queue size, and near-zero packet drops, with both steady and highly varying traffic. In this paper, we investigate the XCP in deep sight; also present a simple network in which XCP is locally stable but globally unstable in the presence of latency. The simulation results verify that XCP remains fairness, high utilization for future high bandwidth-delay product network.

articleTitle: Power allocation for cognitive OFDM with separated interference limits
publicationTitle: IET 3rd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMNN 2010)
abstract: In order to protect primary users' communication, most existing power resource allocation methods focus solely on a total interference limit over all subchannels, which may lead to serious disturbance on some frequencies. In this paper, we investigate the power allocation problem for cognitive OFDM with interference limit on each subcarrier. By formulating the problem as a convex optimization, an optimal iterative allocation algorithm is proposed to maximize the cognitive throughput. Furthermore, a linear sub-optimal algorithm is proposed for fast convergence with little throughput loss. Finally, performances of our proposed algorithms are investigated by simulation results.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of IPv6 controllable multicast in the campus network
publicationTitle: IET 3rd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMNN 2010)
abstract: In allusion to PIM-SSM multicast model work mechanism in the IPv6 campus network, analyzing key technologies of controllable multicast, making use of controllability of network devices for multicast reported packets of multicast user joining (S,G) channel, putting forward PIMSSM controllable multicast realization framework in the IPv6 campus network. Combining with deployment of multicast management server, multicast authentication server, multicast security policy server and multicast monitoring server, constituting management and control with multicast address, multicast source, multicast receiver, and real time monitoring to multicast operating status, achieving muticast operation management and control in order in the IPv6 campus network.

articleTitle: Optimal power allocation for real-time services in OFDM-based cognitive radio systems
publicationTitle: IET 3rd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMNN 2010)
abstract: In this paper, the adaptive power allocation problem on the downlink of a multiuser orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) based cognitive radio (CR) systems with real-time (RT) services is investigated. The objective is to minimize the total transmit power of all CR users with satisfying the minimum bit rate requirements for RT services and limiting the interference to primary users' (PUs) bands below a given threshold. The problem is formulated using convex optimization method and an optimal algorithm is proposed by efficient iteration to search the optimal solution, and the performance of the proposed algorithm is also estimated and compared with that of other methods by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: A comparative analysis on HHT and ANFIS in nonlinear noise cancellation
publicationTitle: IET 3rd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMNN 2010)
abstract: The applications of HHT and ANFIS were studied in nonlinear noise cancellation. Examples were given and compared. The results show that HHT can effectively cancel the high frequency noise when the noise has not too much amplitude overlapped with the original signal, while ANFIS still can do a good filtering job on the too much noise-overlapped signal when HHT fails. The main reasons of the phenomena were discussed. ANFIS benefits from its adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference ability, which is different from the frequency analysis method such as HHT. At last, some useful conclusions were given.

articleTitle: Joint optimization of sensing time and decision thresholds for wideband cognitive OFDM radio networks
publicationTitle: IET 3rd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMNN 2010)
abstract: Cognitive radio (CR) has the ability to sense the wireless channel and make use of the vacant spectrum bands. One of the main challenges in CR systems lies in striking a balance between the conflicting goals of minimizing the interference to the primary user (PU) and maximizing the performance of all secondary users (SUs). A joint optimization strategy of sensing time and decision thresholds for wideband cognitive orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) radio networks is proposed in this paper. The strategy can maximize the opportunistic throughput of all SUs with subjection to the interference constraint under practical conditions. From simulation results we find that optimizing the sensing time and decision thresholds play a key role in maximizing the system throughput.
